The '''Infinity Gavel''' is a [[Weapons#Club|club weapon]] that can be obtained by combining the {{Name|Galaxy Hammer|class=inline}} with {{Name|Galaxy Soul|3|class=inline}} and {{Name|Cinder Shard|60|class=inline}} in the [[Forge]].

Obtaining it unlocks the [[Achievements|Infinite Power]] achievement.

==Trivia==
This is currently the '''melee weapon''' that does the most damage per hit. A [[Master Slingshot]] with [[Iridium Ore]] as ammo does the most damage of all weapons.
